tasks.title: Fix job pause/resume lifecycle race
actions: Introduce a Pausing state or lease-owner guard for running jobs.
Block resume while the job is still registered as running.
Separate cooperative pause from final cancellation.
verify: Resume only after cancellation has fully completed.

tasks.title: Make document import deduplication atomic
actions: Audit existing duplicate document rows.
Add a unique database constraint or equivalent transactional guard for non-null sha256 values.
Handle duplicate import conflicts without creating shared-file delete hazards.

tasks.title: Fix OCR bridge process I/O, timeout, and cancellation behavior
actions: Read stdout and stderr concurrently.
Add explicit timeouts to OCR check, prepare, and recognize operations.
Terminate the process tree on cancellation or timeout.

tasks.title: Move signing material out of the repository workspace
actions: Remove local PFX and password files from the repository tree.
Require an explicit external certificate path or secure prompt/environment variable.
Keep only non-secret certificate documentation in the repo.
verify: Run signing with an external certificate path.
Confirm no signing secret remains under the repository root.

tasks.title: Replace or harden Ollama remote installer execution
actions: Remove or gate the irm | iex PowerShell path.
Prefer manual installation guidance or a pinned, verified installer flow.
Show clear offline and enterprise-policy errors in the UI.
verify: Verify no unpinned remote script is executed automatically.

tasks.title: Reduce unauthenticated health metadata exposure
actions: Keep only a minimal unauthenticated liveness endpoint.
Move vector backend and embedding counters behind authenticated diagnostics.
verify: Call health endpoints without a token.
Call diagnostics with and without a token.

tasks.title: Add frontend unit, component, and e2e coverage
actions: Add tests for Chat, Documents, Settings, error states, and persisted WebView storage.
Add an e2e smoke path for import, job state, backend offline, and preview modal.
verify: Run typecheck, lint, format check, and build.

tasks.title: Split oversized mixed-responsibility files
actions: Split SettingsSection into focused settings panels.
Split DocumentIngestionService by document strategy.
Split InProcessBackend DI, middleware, endpoint, and helper responsibilities.
verify: Run canonical gate after each split batch.

tasks.title: Normalize API contracts and error responses
actions: Add OpenAPI or contract tests for critical backend/frontend DTOs.
Standardize error response shape and status codes.
Avoid surfacing raw external exception details to the UI.
verify: Run frontend typecheck against generated or tested contracts.

tasks.title: Improve polling, stale-state, and shutdown UX
actions: Surface repeated polling failures in the UI.
Track last successful refresh time.
Do not treat active-job API failure as zero active jobs during app exit.
verify: Exit while active jobs endpoint fails.

tasks.title: Add database status constraints and migration checks
actions: Add CHECK constraints or equivalent validation for job and translation statuses.
Create migration checks for existing invalid statuses.
Align code enum-like transitions with database constraints.
verify: Run job and translation lifecycle tests.

tasks.title: Run signed installer lifecycle verification on a clean Windows machine
actions: Sign the installer with trusted signing material outside Git.
Run installer install, first launch, upgrade if applicable, rollback, uninstall, and SmartScreen/signature checks on a clean machine.
verify: Confirm Authenticode signature and timestamp validation.

tasks.title: Run visible installer wizard layout verification
actions: Verify installer wizard pages in a visible desktop session.
Repeat at 100%, 125%, 150%, and 200% display scaling.
Repeat at least once with non-default accessibility text settings.
verify: Record screenshots or exact observations for every wizard page.
Confirm no clipping, overlap, or unreadable controls.

tasks.title: Run interactive desktop and populated UI verification
actions: Launch the WPF/WebView app in a Windows desktop session.
Verify document import, active jobs, retrieval/chat, translation records, settings persistence, and shutdown behavior with representative data.
verify: Run with Ollama-backed workflows when in release scope.
Capture exact defects and reproduction steps.

tasks.title: Finalize release readiness decision after fixes
actions: Re-run the canonical gate.
Re-run relevant targeted tests for every fixed audit finding.
Promote the artifact only if P0 tasks are complete and P1 residual risk is explicitly accepted.
verify: Confirm no unresolved P0 audit finding remains.

residual_scripts: scripts\Bootstrap-Prerequisites.ps1 is oversized and handles prerequisite checks plus dependency installation; keep until a focused split is scheduled.
scripts\Generate-BrandAssets.ps1 is oversized but single-purpose asset generation; keep until brand tooling is refactored.
certificates\app\code_signing.ps1 is an ignored local helper that creates private PFX/password files under the repository; do not use it as a supported automation path.
script_automation_status.last_completed_work: Consolidated the canonical script inventory in scripts\README.md, kept scripts\script.md as a compatibility stub, updated script documentation links, and changed signing scripts to require private PFX material outside the repository or an installed certificate thumbprint.
